improvement: Replicate MS-PEM (participation propensity via gradient boosting, stabilized truncated IPW, piecewise-exponential injury hazard with spline weighted cumulative load lags) on nflverse player-week data as GSE's causal check: flag any injury load feature whose naive coefficient flips sign under IPW as survivor-contaminated.

improvement: Build an automated tout-audit tracker (pre-match timestamped/hashed capture of tout picks verified against sportsbook records) publishing audited ROI reports as competitive content, and run GSE's own picks through the four staking strategies (Flat/Inverse/SquareRoot/Fixed Return) as a sizing baseline battery GSE's Kelly sizing must beat.

improvement: Replace plain Elo in the GSE stack with score-driven Skellam-margin rating (eq. 6-7): run ratings on neutral-site skill with HFA as a separate offset, K and α grid-searched on 1999-2020, and later scale K by Fisher-information normalization (scaled score) so blowouts with high expected variance get smaller effective updates.

improvement: Add a conservative sizing mode to the staking module: after computing unconstrained Kelly stakes, check Σ p_i W_i^{-λ} ≤ 1 (λ=2); if violated, solve the log-scale KKT system for s* and rescale stakes, exposing γ as a user-facing risk slider.
gate: ADOPT if risk-constrained Kelly achieves ≥90% of unconstrained Kelly's final bankroll with max drawdown at least 20% smaller than half-Kelly's, on the 2025–2026 season replay; otherwise REJECT.

improvement: Add urgency features (time-to-kickoff, time-since-posted, time-to-line-close) plus target-aware attention with delta-t temporal encodings and listwise neuralNDCG loss to GSE's time-sensitive surfaces (pre-lock notifications, slate-day pick feeds, live-betting nudges).

improvement: Port the simulation-optimization framework to an NFL WP-optimal 4th-down / 2-point / timeout decision engine (state = score, time, down, distance, field position, timeouts; James-Stein-shrunk situation profiles from nflverse) plus a weekly coach-decision audit content product quantifying each week's most costly decisions in WP points.

improvement: Route all GSE agent tool calls through a single userspace MCP gateway on the Motif VM: JSON-schema validation, trust tiers, per-agent token-bucket rate limits, regex prompt-injection prefilter, ProbeLogits-style semantic gate, constitutional rule list, and an audit chain — plus a layer-7 that probes tool outputs to catch indirect prompt injection from web/MCP content.

improvement: Port the LoRA-ImageBind IMU/text alignment recipe to NFL practice-wearable or NGS-derived motion features for football action classification (route stem, break, catch, block engagement, tackle), feeding weekly practice-load report editorial products.

improvement: Swap GSE's odds-to-probability normalization to parameter-free OO-EPC as the default converter (used in CLV computation and consensus feeds — market-calibration infrastructure, not the objective), and fit FL-GLM favorite-longshot bias β per market per book as a standing mispricing diagnostic that steers where Kelly sizing is most aggressive.

improvement: Build a finite-slate optimizer for GSE's published weekly slate: enumerate count chambers for the joint multinomial over the week's games, solve each shadow-Kelly problem in closed form, select the chamber maximizing α-quantile wealth, and convert the winning wealth profile back to stakes.
gate: ADOPT for the slate optimizer if quantile-Kelly delivers ≥10% higher realized median final bankroll than half-Kelly on the 2025–2026 season replay with no worse 5th-percentile bankroll; otherwise REJECT.

title: TacticGen: Grounding Adaptable and Scalable Generation of Football Tactics
improvement: Train a drive-level diffusion transformer over play descriptors + personnel/formation embeddings, using classifier guidance toward betting objectives (e.g., TD drives, shootout scripts) to produce conditional game-script distributions for derivative pricing and scenario content ('paths to the over hitting').
gate: ADOPT classifier-guided drive generation for scenario/derivative pricing if guided hit rate ≥3x base rate on 2024 held-out drives AND sample entropy ≥70% of unconditional (no collapse).

title: Improvements to the post-processing of weather forecasts using machine learning and feature selection
improvement: Build weather/lgbm_postprocess.py: LightGBM post-processing of HRRR forecasts at all 30 NFL stadiums (11x11 surface + 7x7 pressure-level windows at kickoff lead times, FS0 tau=0.9, Optuna tuned) for temp/wind/precip, paired with the ANET2 probabilistic model as mean + uncertainty.
gate: ADOPT if LightGBM beats raw HRRR by ≥ 10% RMSE on wind speed AND ≥ 5% on temperature on the 2023 holdout (matching the paper's margin scale).

title: Cover Meets Robbins While Betting on Bounded Data: ln n Regret and Almost Sure ln ln n Regret
improvement: Layer a 50-50 Cover-Robbins mixture as the global weekly stake multiplier on top of per-pick Kelly fractions, with anytime-valid edge-monitor gates: scale stakes 1.5x when test wealth W_n >= 20 (rejecting no-edge at alpha=0.05) and halve stakes plus trigger model review when W_n <= 0.5 after >=50 picks.

title: Model Quality in Football: Quantifying the Quality of an Expected Threat Model
improvement: Adopt the bootstrap error-quantification protocol for GSE's possession-value / expected-points surfaces: simulate from the fitted model (>=500 replications), fit log(error) = c + alpha log K + beta log n, and only publish player ratings or prop prices from the surface if P(error < threshold) >= 0.90; otherwise coarsen the grid.

title: The Anatomy of a Decentralized Prediction Market: Microstructure Evidence from the Polymarket Order Book
improvement: Port the CLOB-to-on-chain join pipeline to replicate the eight stylized facts on NFL/CFB Polymarket markets; build a longshot spread-premium curve by sport to downweight wide-spread market prices in GSE's signal fusion; adopt the wash-share lower-bound detector as a market-quality filter before trusting any venue's volume figures.
gate: Adopt the sports-only replication and the spread-premium signal-weighting if direction-agreement and stylized facts replicate within sampling noise.

improvement: Replace the current ensemble combiner with the dampened log-odds pair combiner f_alpha (alpha=0.585) on the two strongest engine components, or the marginal-corrected variant with mu = de-vigged market consensus (alpha=0.656089, gamma=0.498268); backtest walk-forward on picks 2025 vs the current combiner and vs simple average.
gate: ADOPT the dampened log-odds pair combiner if it beats the simple (α=1) average by ≥0.002 Brier on 2025 walk-forward (DM p<0.05) with no log-loss regression; separately ADOPT the marginal-corrected variant if it additionally beats the plain α=0.585 rule by ≥0.001 Brier.

title: Efficient Multivariate Kelly Optimization Reveals Sigmoidal Scaling Laws
improvement: Replace per-pick fractional Kelly on weekly slates with the O(TN) multivariate Kelly Newton-CG solver (joint log-growth maximization over up to ~10 simultaneous picks), and measure how far the independence-assuming solver over-bets on same-game correlated slates to calibrate a correlation guard.
gate: At N = 10 over 100 random instances: max relative error vs brute force ≤ 10⁻⁶; Newton-CG optimum ≥ greedy lower bound on every instance; adopt as the slate stake allocator if it beats current per-pick fractional Kelly on realized log-wealth and max drawdown on Neon picks slates.

improvement: Replace the arbitrary 0.25/0.5 fractional-Kelly multiplier with a principled uncertainty-haircut multiplier derived from the KL gap between the engine's edge D(p-hat||q) and the inf-KL over the uncertainty class (p-hat +/- calibration error bars), sizing in weekly slate blocks rather than per game.
gate: ADOPT the uncertainty-haircut fraction if, on 2024, it achieves ≥90% of full Kelly's log-growth with ≤70% of its maximum drawdown.

title: The Signal Credibility Index for Prediction Markets: A Microstructure-Grounded Diagnostic with Weighted and Time-Varying Extensions
improvement: Port the Signal Credibility Index to line moves as informed-flow surveillance: score each >=1.5-point spread move with PR (price reversion on logit-transformed implied probs), TS (cross-book direction), and cross-book breadth HHI (a move led by Pinnacle/Circa alone = concentrated/informed), re-weighted for information content; use high-SCI_info moves to upweight GSE's own numbers.
gate: Adapt the SCI framework (both flavors) into GSE's steam pipeline if: (i) fitted NFL weights on ≥300 labeled moves achieve AUC ≥ 0.70 for move-side cover prediction; and (ii) the information-content and coordination-credibility flavors rank moves differently (Spearman < 0.6).

title: KellyBench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Sequential Decision Making
improvement: Build GSEBench: a KellyBench-style walk-forward season simulator (weekly slate -> engine probabilities -> fractional-Kelly staking -> settle -> log-wealth) with progressive data disclosure, plus a staking-contract unit test proving the bet-time sizing function equals the specified Kelly function on 100% of placed bets.

title: Information Leakage at Population Scale: An Evaluation of the Polymarket Insider-Relevant Subpopulation, 2020–2026
improvement: Build an NFL ILS analog ('pre-close drift share'): compute each game-week's line movement share before vs. after public anchors (injury report release, inactive list) with a hazard-decay correction for natural drift toward close, and feed anchor-robust early-drift scores into GSE's informed-flow suite.
gate: Adapt the ILS framework into GSE's steam/informed-flow suite if: (i) the anchor-robust subset shows a drift-share/cover correlation significant at p < 0.05 on 2024–2025 NFL; and (ii) the anchor-robustness gate filters out ≥50% of raw flagged games.

improvement: Run a standing Polymarket NFL arb monitor at ~4s top-of-book cadence: flag single-market (Ask_Yes + Ask_No < 1.00) and combinatorial (ML-vs-spread synthetic-short) dislocations with mirrored-liquidity dedup, producing a nightly 'market sharpness' efficiency digest that GSE's own probabilities are measured against.

improvement: Build a skilled-flow watchlist on Polymarket NFL markets: replicate the 10,000-draw sign-randomization test to identify skilled accounts, compute per-market pre-kickoff front-loading (ILS), and weight GSE's line-move signals by whether they originate from watchlist accounts.
gate: ADAPT is confirmed if, on 2024 Polymarket NFL data, the sports-only replication achieves ≥35% out-of-sample retention of the skilled-winner label AND high-ILS markets show ≥4pp better move→outcome prediction than unflagged markets.

improvement: Replace the empirical-disagreement abstention rule with Lipschitz-forced selection heads (spectral-normalized, trained on oracle post/don't-post labels from graded picks): post only games in the forced set computed from the Lipschitz envelope over the slate's game embeddings, then tighten bounds with local per-region Lipschitz constants.

improvement: Adopt leave-one-player-out as a mandatory validation gate for all GSE player-level prop models (report LOPO R2/MAE alongside pooled CV as the honest generalization estimate for new players), and add a signed-residual 'efficiency' metric for players systematically outperforming their statistical inputs.

improvement: Deploy SHARP as GSE's production policy layer: transcribe current production logic into a bounded rubric (<=40 condition-action rules over engine features), and run a weekly attribution agent that maps the 20 worst betting days to rule IDs, proposes atomic edits with full audit trails (rule ID -> error days -> validation score), and checks rule-interaction effects before accepting any edit.

improvement: Compute the hybrid signal Gamma^hyb (slippage-analog + liability-analog) weekly on GSE's pick/stake log as a state-dependent exposure framework: scale slate stakes inversely with the liability component so GSE's exposure adapts to correlated-slate risk, with the mixture construction's (1/beta)log M overhead guarantee bounding the cost of adaptivity.
gate: Adapt the mixture construction and the hybrid signal as GSE's state-dependent exposure framework if the liability component correlates with realized drawdowns on GSE's log.

improvement: Add heteroscedastic uncertainty to GSE's trajectory forecaster: attach the L_NLL head (lambda=0.01, stop-grad on mean) with diagonal-Jacobian reverse Gaussian sampling onto the existing diffusion model, and train RankNN (K=20 modes, differentiable Spearman vs SADE) to e-rank modes — the Top-1 mode plus calibrated per-state ellipses give the pick and the position size.
gate: ADOPT the U2Diffine/RankNN delta if ALL of the following hold on the held-out test: (i) AccRate@95% ≥ 90% on football tracking; (ii) median Spearman ρ between e and SADE ≥ 0.50; (iii) e-ranked Top-1 minSADE20 beats random Top-1 by ≥8%; (iv) U2Diff sampling cost ≤ 20ms/mode at K=20.

title: Exploitation of Hidden Context in Dynamic Movement Forecasting: A Neural Network Journey from Recurrent to Graph Neural Networks and General Purpose Transformers
improvement: Adopt the CNN-LSTM context architecture (kernel adapted to football's frame rate; static landmarks = goal line, end zones, first-down line) for ball-carrier + nearest-defender 2s trajectory forecasting from NGS tracking, sweeping input lengths 0.5-4.0s.

improvement: Calibrate GSE NFL team strengths per game to kickoff consensus lines (The Odds API consensus): minimize the sum of squared gaps between market-implied and engine probs over spread/moneyline/total implied probs, with the totals market fixing the absolute scoring level (identifiability fix), and report the calibration-shift distribution per team as an engine-honesty diagnostic.
gate: Accept into the engine lane if: (1) the kickoff-calibration objective is implemented and its identifiability fix (totals-equivalent market) documented; (2) held-out accuracy/RPS/log-loss reported against market-implied probabilities; (3) any profitability claim passes the goal-window-style timing control.

title: TrajTok: Adaptive Spatial Tokenization for Trajectory Representation Learning
improvement: Build adaptive H3 spatial tokenization from 7 seasons of player positions (vocab 1.5-3k cells, fine near LOS, coarse deep), train the factorized encoder with co-masked objective (mask ratio 0.30) + ST-RoPE, freeze it, and attach adapters for play-similarity retrieval, route-family classification, and ball-carrier yards-gained regression.
gate: ADOPT if: (a) adaptive-tokenizer retrieval MRR ≥ 15% above fixed-resolution baseline on held-out weeks, AND (b) frozen-encoder route classification macro-F1 ≥ 0.60.

title: Entrywise Error Bounds for Spectral Ranking with Semi-Random Adversaries
improvement: Add MMWU-reweighted rank centrality as a GSE power-rating component: run the SDP/greedy edge reweighting maximizing the spectral gap on the season's comparison graph (downweights intra-division echo-chamber games, upweights inter-conference games), and publish 1/lambda_{n-1}(L^W) as a spectral-gap confidence diagnostic on every rating.
gate: Adopt reweighted spectral ratings as a GSE model component if MMWU-reweighted rank centrality beats unweighted on end-of-season l_infty error (vs batch-BTL) in ≥ 5 of 7 test seasons AND on next-week SU log-loss by ≥ 0.001/game averaged over 2018–2024.

improvement: Replace fixed-K Elo updates with a drift-calibrated step eta = c*sqrt(Delta-hat), where Delta-hat is per-week skill drift estimated from batch-BTL weekly fits (c tuned on 2021-2022), and publish trailing-averaged ratings with the Theorem-29-certified window T instead of point-in-time ratings.
gate: Adopt drift-calibrated η for GSE's online ratings if it beats fixed-K Elo on next-week SU log-loss by ≥ 0.002/game averaged over 2020–2024 AND the optimal tuned c is stable across the tuning and test windows.

title: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players
improvement: Build an NFL play-transition world model: 23 tokens (22 players + ball) per timestep with Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding (pool V=32, no learned player-slot embeddings so trades/call-ups need no retraining), Sparse Hub Attention with K=8 hubs, flow-matching training on NGS tracking transitions; then dedicate hub slots to ball state, down/distance/clock, formation, and defensive shell as semantically structured hubs.

title: Low Rank for Rank: Uncertainty-Aware Task-Specific LLM Ranking under Sparse Pairwise Comparisons
improvement: Fit a low-rank context-specific team-strength matrix (rows = game-context clusters from spread/total/rest/dome/divisional, columns = 32 teams; nuclear-norm + refinement BTL on outcomes) for early-season sparse contexts, and run three-way pick certification (certified vs unresolved) on the weekly published sheet.
gate: Adopt the low-rank context-rating estimator if it beats per-context BTL on next-season SU log-loss by ≥ 0.003/game averaged over the 2023–2024 test seasons AND produces strictly narrower mean rank CIs at ≥ nominal coverage on a 2024 holdout.

title: Betting Against Integrity: Identifying Match-Fixing Through In-Play Market Dynamics
improvement: Fit a hurdle-ARX(1) state-space model on public NFL live odds (The Odds API in-game, 1-minute resolution; covariates: pre-game implied probs, score diff, time remaining, timeouts, events); use standardized residuals vs expected activity as a live-betting edge signal — flagged cells that cluster before line moves the pre-game model missed become GSE's steam/stale-line detector.

title: SVI-Bench: A Dynamic Microworld for Strategic Video Intelligence
improvement: Replicate the SVI data-engine pattern for NFL: game-clock alignment of broadcast clips to nflverse play-by-play, cross-modal entity resolution into per-game identity graphs, LLM-assisted QA/forecast instance generation, three-stage QC; adopt the T5 multiple-choice outcome-forecasting eval protocol (fixed observation windows, target events beyond the window) for GSE's forecasting models.

improvement: Run a weekly stability audit on GSE's published pick sheet: cluster games into matchup-context clusters, define cluster preference as realized pick profitability within cluster, compute gamma-hat per weekly top-k prefix; if excluded picks are systematically preferred by cohesive game-type subgroups, restructure the sheet with checkpoint-blockwise stable construction.
gate: Adopt the stability audit as a standing weekly check if the backtest finds γ̂ > 1 violations in ≥ 15% of weeks at any k ≤ 5 (2022–2024).

title: AdaWeather: Adaptively Mixing Probabilistic Weather Forecasts with Logarithmic Regret
improvement: Add a hybrid forecast combiner for GSE's sub-model predictive distributions (spread/total/win-prob): offline gradient-boosted combiner trained on 2020-2023 forecasts-to-outcomes plus an online exponentially-weighted CRPS mixture over sub-models + the offline combiner, updated weekly with strictly causal updates.
gate: ADOPT if the hybrid beats both the offline-only and online-only ablations on CRPS (≥2% each) and its cumulative regret vs. the season BIH stays within the logarithmic envelope (no linear-regret regime).

title: Regularization in Paired Comparison Models via Pseudo-Games and Phantom Players
improvement: Regularize GSE's weekly in-season BT power ratings with phantom players: fit weekly BT on nflverse with a zero-strength phantom opponent and rho tuned by leave-one-week-out CV, so one early blowout cannot create an extreme rating while average teams stay untouched.
gate: Adopt phantom-player regularization for GSE's weekly in-season ratings if it beats ordinary BT on remaining-season log-loss in ≥ 17 of 24 test windows (weeks 1–8 × 2022–2024) AND beats or ties ridge BT on the same windows.

title: Rethinking Sales Lead Scoring with LLM-based Hierarchical Preference Ranking
improvement: Weight GSE's team-rating BT fits by game informativeness via tiered-margin BT: fit P(i beats j | m) = sigma(theta_i - theta_j - m) with margins m=1.0 for playoff games, 0.5 for late-season contender games, 0.1 for early-season games, so ratings separate more on high-information games; then learn the tier margins end-to-end constrained non-increasing.
gate: Adopt if the tiered-margin BT beats static BT on next-season SU log-loss by ≥ 0.005 per game (averaged over the 2022–2024 rolling test seasons) AND the margin ablation shows tiered ≻ uniform ≻ none.

title: Multi-objective probabilistic forecast combination for inventory demand
improvement: Choose GSE's model-zoo combination weights with NSGA-III over (log-loss on outcomes, Kelly-simulated bankroll growth) on a rolling validation season and deploy the Pareto-knee weight vector — optimizing the actual betting objective rather than pure accuracy.
gate: ADOPT the knee-weight combination if, on the 2024 test season, it achieves bankroll ROI ≥ the log-loss-optimal weights' ROI while its log-loss is within 2% of the log-loss-optimal.

title: GITCO: Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization in TSFMs
improvement: Wrap GSE's frozen sports TSFM in a Gate->Router->Critic->SMA serving module: train the gate on leave-one-game-out influence labels (did removing game X improve the forecast?), add a regime-shift detector probe (coaching/QB change) that forces gate abstention so genuine regime changes are never smoothed, and default to abstention since gate precision > recall is the safe direction.
gate: ADOPT as a default-on serving wrapper if the sports gate achieves ≥70% precision on 2022–2024 AND mean MASE reduction ≥1.5% with no season worse than baseline; keep it default-off if precision is 60–70%; REJECT if precision <60% or any season degrades.

title: Conformal Risk-Averse Decision Making with Action Conditional Guarantee
improvement: Add an action-conditional conformal bet/no-bet filter (alpha=0.05, utility = realized profit) over the engine's calibrated outcome distributions on a rolling 4-week calibration set, publishing the guaranteed profit floor certificate nu(x) conditioned on betting; extend to utility-conditional stake tiers (0, 0.25f*, 0.5f*, f*) so the max-min rule selects the largest stake whose worst-case certified utility is positive.
gate: ACCEPT if ALL hold on the 3-season backtest: (1) empirical action-conditional coverage ≥95% where AC-RAC selects 'bet'; (2) Sharpe_AC-RAC ≥ 1.10 x Sharpe_baseline AND Calmar_AC-RAC ≥ 1.10 x Calmar_baseline; (3) bet volume ≥ 30% of baseline volume.

title: Watch, Remember, Reason: Human-View Video Understanding with MLLMs
improvement: Structure GSE's broadcast-video pipeline as watch->remember->reason: watch = the tracking stack (detections, tracks, play grounding), remember = a play-structured game memory keyed on play boundaries with evidence pointers to timestamps, reason = query-driven evidence retrieval returning timestamp/box-grounded answers (e.g., 'every 3rd-and-long blitz in Q3' returns clips + boxes, not text).
gate: ADAPT the architecture (watch–remember–reason with budgeted evidence search) for GSE's video lane if: the primary read-throughs (DeepSport, FineQuest) replicate their core claims on inspection, and a prototype reasoner on the NFL query set beats uniform-sampling VLM QA by ≥ 15 points of answer accuracy with evidence IoU ≥ 0.5.

title: Bradley-Terry Rankings for Recommender Systems Across Dataset Taxonomies
improvement: Build regime-conditional team strength via fusion-regularized covariate BT: weekly win matrices over recent seasons with covariates (home/away, rest differential, dome/outdoor, wind bucket, QB-missing flags) fit by L-BFGS-B to get beta_{i0} + <x, beta_i>, usable as a regime-sliced margin-model feature; adopt the transitive-triplet ratio of weekly implied rankings as a standing model-selection metric.
gate: Adopt the covariate-BT component if, on the 2022–2024 rolling test seasons, it beats the static-BT baseline by ≥ 0.01 log-loss per game AND achieves a higher transitive-triplet ratio on weekly implied rankings, with no worse top-3 overlap.

title: When Do Markets Fully Process Public Information? Evidence from Real-Time Prediction Markets
improvement: Build GSE's own out-of-sample in-play win-probability benchmark on nflverse play-by-play (cross-fit, no market input) and audit in-play market updating: estimate Delta p = alpha + beta Delta q to replicate the <1 updating finding on 2024-2025 NFL, then restrict drift-following to cross-book opportunities where a soft retail book lags a sharp book (Pinnacle) — executable because the stale price is taken, not the lagging book's spread.
gate: Adapt the updating-gap framework into GSE's in-play product if, on 2024–2025 NFL: (i) β is significantly below 1 and drift ρ significantly positive net of benchmark changes; and (ii) the drift-follow signal survives bid–ask costs with positive expected value over ≥500 in-play events, OR the liquidity-gated blender beats a fixed 50/50 market/model blend on Brier score by ≥0.002.

title: What Went Wrong with Data Lakes? A 15-Year Reality Check from the Field
improvement: Adopt a quarterly swamp-indicator dashboard over GSE's feature store / signal inventory: per-table owner, metadata completeness (target >=90%), 90-day dormancy flags, full source lineage, duplication <20%; trajectory over quarters (not thresholds) is the metric, and deteriorating quarters trigger the stage-based intervention actions.
gate: ADOPT the dashboard + quarterly GDAM iff: (a) all six indicators are computable (no missing-instrumentation gaps) within one quarter; (b) metadata completeness ≥90% and duplication <20% at first full run; (c) quarterly re-run takes <2 hours of operator time.

title: Lost in the Non-convex Loss Landscape: How to Fine-tune the Large Time Series Model? (SFF)
improvement: Make SFF the default fine-tuning initializer for every sports-TSFM fine-tune (Chronos, Moirai, Lag-Llama, TimesFM): Theta_3 = alpha Theta_1* + (1-alpha) Theta_2 with alpha from {0.5, 0.7} selected on the season-before-test; always run standard full-FT alongside and log the delta to build GSE's internal evidence base.
gate: ADOPT SFF as the default fine-tuning initializer if it beats standard full-FT on MSE in the majority of test seasons with no CRPS regression >1%; keep it as an option (not default) if results are mixed; REJECT as default if it underperforms standard FT in 2+ seasons.

title: Improving Sharpness in Neural Network Parametric Post-processing
improvement: Train GSE's probabilistic post-processor for game totals (and discrete props) with CRPSmod instead of pure CRPS: Gaussian-family loss with an interval-width penalty (alpha tuned 0.001-0.02 on 2024 walk-forward) to produce sharper central intervals at matched coverage, guarded by a live coverage monitor that rolls back alpha if realized coverage drops >1 point below nominal.
gate: ADOPT CRPSmod training if on 2025 frozen test the central-90% interval narrows by ≥5% vs. pure-CRPS training, empirical coverage stays within ±0.5pp of nominal, and mean CRPS does not regress (paired test p<0.05 for width, non-inferiority for CRPS).

title: ERBench: A Benchmark and Testsuite for Equation Discovery Algorithms
improvement: Make the ERBench 200-formula panel the mandatory regression test for GSE's symbolic-regression pipeline: run the sports-config PySR on all 200 formulas, score Symbolic Recovery/JI/TED plus failure-boundary diagnostic sweeps (recovery vs complexity, noise 0-5%, sample size, domain); no SR config ships to the engine without beating the previous Recovery/JI — and build a SportsEq dev set (~100 known sports formulas: Elo, Glicko-2, TrueSkill, Pythagorean, Kelly, Dixon-Coles).
gate: ADAPT if: GSE's current sports-config PySR scores Recovery < 0.40 on the 200-formula panel AND the diagnostic sweeps identify at least one concrete failure axis that a ledger 2166–2172 upgrade is designed to fix.

title: Mix, Don't Pick: Why Synthetic Corpus Composition Matters for Time Series Foundation Model Pretraining
improvement: Adopt the MixedSports recipe for all sports-TSFM pretraining: build sports generator families (score-dynamic with key numbers, possession/pacing, usage random walks, injury-shock regime shifts, volatility regimes, market-line generators with known inefficiencies), run matched-budget sweeps (1M windows per family), and train on the equal-weight mixture + real data, then add adversarial generator mining on the mixture's residual errors.
gate: ADOPT the MixedSports recipe for all sports-TSFM pretraining if the mixture matches/beats the best single generator on the held-out-season sweep AND real+synthetic beats real-only.

title: Monte Carlo Pass Search: Using Trajectory Generation for 3D Counterfactual Pass Evaluation in Football
improvement: Build gse_counterfactual_decision_eval.py: train a discrete-token autoregressive world model on NGS tracking (k-means motion vocabularies, 8->24 token rollouts) plus a possession-value head; for each QB throw/fourth-down decision sample execution-noise and global variants, roll out to the next meaningful interaction, score delta-PV, and report S_mean/S_pct per decision per player plus VaR/CVaR tail-risk summaries of the delta-PV distribution for fantasy sit/start.
gate: world-model minADE20 must beat constant-velocity by ≥ 30%; decision-eval pilot on 200 labeled fourth-down decisions must show S_pct separating known-good from known-bad calls (rank correlation with EPA outcome ≥ 0.4).

title: Selective Mask Propagation for Multi-Object Tracking
improvement: Adopt the margin-dispatched orchestration pattern for GSE's broadcast-footage tracking lane: base tracker (ByteTrack) every frame, expensive modules (VOS mask propagation, jersey OCR) firing only on margin-signal windows, with the asymmetric override rule (expensive output overrides the base only when confident AND contradicting), plus NFL GTA (pose-guided jersey OCR + team classification).
gate: ADAPT the dispatch + gated-correction design if, on the NFL annotation set, adding margin-dispatched VOS improves AssA by ≥ 3.0 points over the base tracker with the same detections, and false-positive SWAPs stay below 10% of SWAP windows.

title: From Uncertain Judgments to Calibrated Rankings: Conformal Elo Estimation for LLM Evaluation
improvement: Fit GSE's BT/Elo team ratings with margin-calibrated soft targets: temperature beta via MLE mapping point-margin to win probability sigma(beta*m), soft target y-tilde = sigma(beta**m) per game instead of 0/1 (fixes the stretched ruler where ratings over-react to close wins), and wrap weekly power ratings in split-conformal 90% intervals with regime-dependent (Mondrian) temperatures and quantiles.
gate: Adopt if soft-target BT reduces held-out-season Elo-vs-market MAE by ≥ 10% relative (averaged over the 10 leave-one-season-out folds) with Δρ ≥ −0.01, AND conformal intervals achieve empirical coverage within [85%, 95%] at 90% nominal with median width ≤ 80% of the hard-target variant's width.

title: Simulation-Augmented Multi-Step Split Conformal Prediction for Aggregated Forecasts
improvement: Adopt simulation-augmented multi-step split conformal for GSE's season-total markets (win totals, season yards/TDs): expanding-window game-level residual collection, center horizon-wise residuals, block bootstrap (b=4 weeks) of 10,000 remaining-season paths, aggregate to 90/95% intervals, then combine with conformal PID online adaptation of quantile levels as the season progresses.
gate: ADOPT SA-MSCP for season-total intervals if, on the 2023–2024 holdout, empirical coverage of realised win totals is ≥80% at nominal 90% AND mean interval width is no more than 1.5x the naive baseline width.

title: Counterfactual Optimization of Baseball Pitch Sequences and Estimation of Its Impact on Season-Level Statistics
improvement: Port the micro-counterfactual to macro-stat bridge to NFL 4th downs: train a drive-outcome/WP model on pre-play state + decision, swap each historical 4th-down decision counterfactually holding context fixed, aggregate per-coach mean gaps, and regress coach season EPA-per-drive on the gap as a coach decision-quality metric; then run the multi-objective Pareto (WP, EPA, coverage risk) version for game-plan cards.
gate: ADAPT the framework if, on the nflverse 4th-down test: (a) the per-coach optimal-vs-actual output gap correlates with season EPA/drive at |r| ≥ 0.5 on the held-out 2025 window, and (b) the estimated Δwin upper bound is stable across two adjacent held-out windows (2024, 2025).

title: ForecastBench-Sim: A Simulated-World Forecasting Benchmark
improvement: Build a simulated-world calibration benchmark: freeze halftime game states, pose engine questions (final margin, total, 2H points), resolve by Monte-Carlo rollout of a drive-level game simulator (1,000+ sims), score Brier/CRPS against sim-resolved outcomes, run interventional mutations (QB injury, weather shift) to test counterfactual calibration, and generate adversarial tail states (4th-quarter 1-score games, extreme weather) where the bankroll lives or dies.
gate: ADOPT sim-resolved calibration if engine calibration curves against sim-resolved outcomes match real-outcome calibration within ±0.05 slope on 2024.

title: Rigorous uncertainty quantification of probabilistic AI weather forecasts with conformal prediction
improvement: Add weather/conformal.py: sequential conformal corrections (Eq. 2-4, alpha=0.1/0.2, eta=0.01, trailing-365-day calibration window) wrapping the ANET2 probabilistic forecast's quantile output per stadium x lead time x variable, layered after the LGBM bias correction (bias fix first, conformal spread second); later add separate upper/lower corrections for extremes (top-5% wind/precip games) since 95th-percentile events still undercover.
gate: ADOPT if, within 30 days of simulated burn-in, empirical coverage at 90% lands within ±0.02 of nominal for temperature and wind across ≥ 25/30 stadiums, with CRPS no worse than raw.

title: Selective Time Series Forecasting via Metalearning
improvement: Build a CatBoost meta-regressor predicting each pick's error percentile from pre-game structural descriptors (spread/total movement stats, rest, injury count, back-to-back flag, line sharpness proxy); withhold from posting when predicted error percentile >= q (calibrated to a target posting coverage, e.g. 80%), and validate the zero-shot/adapted protocol NFL->NBA/MLB with 30% target-league adaptation.
gate: ADOPT if held-out meta-level ρ ≥ 0.4 and kept-pick hit rate at 80% coverage improves ≥1.5 pp over keep-all with the metamodel beating the interval-width baseline.

title: Predicting the 2026 FIFA World Cup with Sufficient Dimension Reduction of Elo Rating Histories
improvement: Replace GSE's single current-rating-difference feature in the game-outcome head with 2 SIR/SAVE SDR scores from K=6 lagged weekly rating differences (whitened, 3-class slices cover/no-cover/over-under), and run the 2x2 cover x over/under slice design so the second SAVE direction becomes a high-variance-game-script (weather, backup QB) totals feature.
gate: ADAPT if the SDR-score model reduces mean log-loss vs the current-difference baseline by ≥0.005 on the 2025 test window with the same feature budget (no extra raw inputs).

title: Learning Probabilistic Filters with Strictly Proper Scoring Rules
improvement: Train an energy-score (beta=1) neural ensemble filter as GSE's live probabilistic game-state updater (score/timeouts/field-position dynamics), benchmarked against bootstrap particle and ensemble Kalman filters, serving with N<=100 ensemble members at inference; test on a misspecified simulator with an online recalibration head to measure the real-world robustness gap.
gate: ADAPT into a GSE game-state module if the energy-score-trained NN filter matches the particle filter within 5% energy-score on simulated NFL game-state trajectories with N≤100 at inference time.

title: BetXplain: An Explanation-Annotated Dataset for Detecting Manipulative Betting Advertisements on Social Media
improvement: Deploy a compliance filter on GSE's affiliate promo copy, sportsbook ad creatives, and sponsored content: sample 500-1,000 promos, triple-annotate with the paper's 3-class taxonomy (Cohen's kappa reported), fine-tune ELECTRA (5 epochs, AdamW, lr 2e-5, inverse-frequency weighted CE) to flag manipulative/deceptive patterns for human review before publication.
gate: Adopt if macro-F1 ≥ 0.65 on triple-annotated held-out promos with annotator κ ≥ 0.6 AND deceptive-class F1 ≥ 0.60 (the paper's 0.511 is the bar to clear).

title: Bayesian Best-Arm Identification with Abstention: A Polynomial-to-Exponential Phase Transition
improvement: Evaluate engine versions with inverse-gap-weighted allocation (PGWS): allocate backtest/paper-trade weeks p_i proportional to 1/gap^2 across the production engine + challenger configs, and gate shipping on the Bayesian abstention rule — keep the incumbent iff R_T < r-hat_{T,alpha}, with an adaptive abstention budget alpha_t tied to the cost of a bad ship vs the cost of another evaluation week.
gate: ADAPT the allocation rule iff inverse-gap weighting reaches the same ship-decision confidence with ≥20% fewer evaluation weeks than equal-split on historical version comparisons.

title: Experience Graphs: The Data Foundation for Self-Improving Agents (Trellis)
improvement: Build the GSE experience graph (Postgres/SQLite) as the discovery loop's substrate: nodes attempt/artifact/reward/comparison/reflection with derived_from/supersedes edges; query-based access ('what was the frontier last night?' answered <2 min), crash recovery from the frontier query (<5 min, zero duplicate backtests), and a weekly automated experience-mining job flagging bad implementations (sibling underperformance), dead lanes, and recurring failure reflections.
gate: ADOPT as the loop's substrate if: analyst query-time test passes (<2 min), crash recovery <5 min with zero duplicate backtests over 3 induced crashes, replay fidelity 5/5, and storage stays <10 GB after 30 nights.

title: Verifiable Rewards for Calibrated Probabilistic Forecasting
improvement: Replace/augment GSE's Platt/isotonic probability calibration with calibration against an empirical-rate teacher: bucket historical pick outcomes by (model prob decile, days-to-kickoff, spread bin, league) with hierarchical empirical-Bayes backoff (M=25 pseudocounts), fit the calibrator to minimize squared error vs teacher rates p-hat(x) rather than binary outcomes (removing Bernoulli noise), then distill toward a learned gradient-boosted rate model that adds line movement.
gate: ADAPT if calibrator (b) reduces test-window ECE by ≥20% relative vs (a) with Brier no worse than (a) within 0.002.

title: Ledger 0796 — Decentralized Aggregation of LLM Predictions via Wagering Mechanisms (WALLA)
improvement: Give GSE's ensemble per-game learned weights via WALLA's advantage-aligned rule: train one small MLP per signal source on pre-game features (injury flags, line movement, weather, rest) to predict w_i^* = ((s_i - b_{-i})/2c_3)^+ (per-game Brier advantage vs the leave-one-out pool), aggregate with linear pooling p-hat = sum w_i p_i / W, and test a decision-weighted advantage target A_i^dec = u*(s_i - b_{-i}) with u = realized CLV or Kelly fraction.
gate: Season-2 backtest: advantage-aligned aggregation must beat equal-weight aggregation by ≥ 1.5% Brier score and achieve D-Regret ≤ 30% of the equal-weight gap to oracle before production. DM test at 5%.

title: Attention Limited Reward Learning
improvement: Add a cycle-consistency diagnostic to GSE's pairwise rating machinery: build dense comparison graphs (engine-variant pairwise win rates across backtest weeks, or multiple power-rating sources), compute the Hodge decomposition of the empirical log-odds field, report cyclic energy share vs a parametric bootstrap null; when the diagnostic fires, fit regime-conditioned BT r_i(x) = theta_i + phi_i^T x instead of scalar ratings.
gate: ADAPT the diagnostic into the model-evaluation pipeline if: (a) on engine-variant comparison data the cyclic energy share exceeds the bootstrap null at p<0.05, OR (b) even under the null, the one-eighth-law misfit price is material (>0.01 bits/comparison).

title: When Do Prophets Profit in Prediction Markets?
improvement: Implement Brier proper-bet sizing for GSE's daily card: stake w proportional to (p_GSE - q_market) clipped by a liquidity proxy (expected line-move per dollar from book-count/depth data) instead of flat or Kelly; log per-pick realized CLV decomposed into score gap (accuracy), divergence (disagreement payoff), and liquidity cost as the sizing feedback loop; extend to multi-book shopping with a fourth shopping-bonus term.
gate: ADAPT is confirmed if, on the 2024-season backtest, proper-Brier staking beats both flat staking and Kelly on realized ROI with statistical significance (paired bootstrap, 5%) and the three-term decomposition attributes ≥60% of the gain to the score-gap term.

title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
improvement: Impose Pitwall's three-part discipline on the GSE engine: (1) bound-constrained parameter set with documented physical bounds and a gating rule — every component gets its own full recalibration on the training window and is evaluated only on the held-out window with its own parameters, optimizing J = rho_Spearman - 2*Brier - ECE, with parity gating (golden-hash regression on a fixed fixture) behind feature flags; (2) CRN counterfactuals for in-play hedge/cash-out decisions under shared random seeds with bootstrap CIs; (3) a typed claim verifier that extracts claims from drafted X posts and rejects any draft contradicted by the engine state snapshot.
gate: Accept into the calibration lane if: (1) the bound-constrained parameter set is defined and documented; (2) at least one engine change is gated with the full recalibrate-both-configs protocol and the decision recorded; (3) the X-post claim verifier covers ≥90% of extractable claims per post with 0 contradicted claims published.

title: Volatility in Prediction Markets: A Structural Approach
improvement: Add a DR-AS structural volatility forecaster over GSE's odds data (de-vigged consensus p_t, hours-to-kickoff tau_t, cross-book spread s_t as the adverse-selection proxy, book-move-count volume proxy V_t) whose predicted remaining-move scale drives CLV confidence, bet-size scaling, and abstention.
gate: ADOPT the structural forecaster if, on the 2025 NFL holdout, DR-AS improves on the GARCH(1,1) baseline by >=15% in volume-weighted interval score with the paired-bootstrap difference significant at 5%. REJECT (keep GARCH or constant vol) if the gain is <10% or insignificant — then cross-book spread is not a sufficient adverse-selection proxy in bookmaker (non-CLOB) markets.

title: Objective and subjective entropy measures of portfolio suboptimality
improvement: Rank GSE's staking rules (quarter-Kelly, half-Kelly, variance-budgeted Kelly) by the Kelly-gap 1/2||theta - alpha sigma^T pi*||^2 on the Neon picks history, so divergence between realized log-wealth ranking and Kelly-gap ranking isolates estimation error from structural strategy shortfall.
gate: Simulated GBM (theta=0.4, sigma=0.2, T=1, 100k paths): for alpha=0.5, the analytic gap 1/2(1-alpha)^2||theta||^2 must match the Monte Carlo mean log-wealth ratio within +-2 standard errors before applying the Kelly-gap ranking to GSE's staking-rule horse race.

title: Generalizing Preference-based Reinforcement Learning: a Rationality Model for Incomparability
improvement: Add a multi-objective pick-selection layer that fits an MOBT softmax over GSE's posted-vs-skipped and abstained pick pairs to recover Garrett's implicit weights over edge, cover probability, and variance, replacing the scalar pick-score ranking with a Pareto-frontier filter.
gate: ADOPT the multi-objective selection layer if on 2025 H1 the MOBT model achieves >=0.05 nats/comparison better test log-likelihood than the scalar BT baseline AND the Pareto-frontier filter on 2025 H2 yields posted-pick CLV >= the scalar-ranking baseline's CLV with no worse cover rate. REJECT if the incomparability labels are uninformative (MOBT ~= BT log-likelihood) or the comparison dataset has <500 usable pairs.

title: Training-Free Off-Screen Player Imputation for Broadcast-Based Spatial Football Analytics
improvement: Implement role-anchored centroid-voting imputation (the paper's B4 training-free baseline) as the front end for any GSE broadcast-video tracking lane, benchmarked against the ignore policy on decision-relevant NFL metrics (pre-snap box-count estimate, receiver separation at throw) rather than trajectory fidelity.
gate: Adopt B4 (or a better learned variant) into the GSE tracking pipeline if it cuts the decision-relevant NFL metric error to <=50% of the ignore policy on the held-out weeks; reject broadcast-video tracking for that metric (stick to play-by-play sources) if B4 fails to beat the ignore policy.

title: When Directional Accuracy Lies: A Base-Rate-Honest Benchmark for LoRA-Adapted TimesFM on Equity Forecasting
improvement: Make the base-rate honesty harness (excess accuracy vs always-favorite/always-home/always-under plus closing-line baselines, McNemar/DM tests with BH-FDR, frozen versioned artifacts) mandatory for every GSE model evaluation so no model ships on raw hit-rate alone.
gate: ADOPT the honesty harness as mandatory for all future GSE model evaluations if it successfully reproduces the paper's base-rate demonstration on the sanity dataset AND flags >=1 currently-believed GSE edge as a base-rate artifact on re-scoring; any model whose only evidence is raw hit-rate without base-rate comparison is automatically REJECTED from live consideration.

title: Prices, Probabilities, and Parlays: Systematic Bias in Sports Prediction Markets
improvement: Apply a time-to-expiry-conditioned (TTE-bucketed power-logit/Platt) calibration map to every GSE market-implied probability before it enters the engine, plus a parlay-specific calibration audit comparing SGP quoted prices against the product of book leg prices.
gate: ADAPT the TTE-conditional calibration into GSE's market-implied pipeline if, on one held-out NFL season: (a) the [0,10)-minute bucket gamma-hat differs from the pooled estimate with p<0.05 AND the TTE-conditional map improves log-loss over the pooled map by >=0.005 nats; (b) for parlays, adopt the parlay-specific calibration only if median R deviates from 1.0 by >=2% in the 2-5 leg cells.

title: Risk-Aware Preference Learning for Stochastic Outcomes
improvement: Fit the Prelec probability-distortion curve w(p)=exp(-(-ln p)^gamma) from GSE engine probabilities to market-implied probabilities per market segment and switch the EV pipeline's edge selector to the CPT-adjusted edge when the fitted gamma sits significantly below 1.
gate: ADAPT into the EV pipeline if: (a) fitted gamma < 1 with 95% CI excluding 1 on the training window AND (b) the CPT-adjusted edge selector beats the naive edge selector by >=2pp ROI on the 2024-2025 holdout. REJECT if gamma ~= 1 or the CPT adjustment adds no ROI — the distortion must be measured, never assumed.

title: ContinuityBench: A Benchmark and Systems Study of Stateful Failover in Multi-Provider LLM Routing
improvement: Build a HandoffBench for the GSE agent-bus that plants 2-3 factual anchors in every parent-to-subagent task and measures the Handoff Preservation Rate of returned reports with a calibrated LLM judge, turning anchor loss into a standing reliability metric.
gate: ADAPT if: (a) the continuitybench harness reproduces the treatment-vs-baseline CPR gap (treatment >=95%, baseline <=5%); (b) the retry-storm repro shows fixed-interval retries destabilizing and jittered backoff stabilizing; (c) judge calibration on 20 hand-labeled handoff cases reaches >=90% agreement. Adopt HPR as a standing gate only if a pilot shows >=1 anchor-loss event the parent would otherwise not have caught.

title: FailureAtlas: A Taxonomy of Failure Modes in Multi-Provider LLM Serving Infrastructure
improvement: Run the paper's 5x2 failure-mode grid as a reliability audit over every hop between GSE code and its model/API providers (OmniRoute routes, odds polling, agent-bus messaging), classifying each hop and fixing the found defects as scheduled ops hardening rather than research.
gate: ADAPT if: (a) all three released reproduction scripts reproduce their claimed failure mechanisms on the lab VM (shared-state turn loss; synchronized-retry saturation vs jitter success; index=0 emission), and (b) the grid classifies every surveyed issue example without forcing. This is infrastructure hygiene, not a prediction edge — schedule as ops hardening.

title: Optimal Market Making in Prediction Markets
improvement: Fit the sigma(t,x)=sigma_0+sigma_1(t/T)^eta+sigma_2/(1+x^2) volatility spec to GSE's in-game win-probability paths per sport and add the exposure-skew rule plus the terminal settlement penalty to pick-slate selection so published confidence flattens against directional exposure hardest at coin-flip prices.
gate: Adapt the volatility specification and the skew/penalty rules if sigma(t,x) beats constant-volatility on GSE's win-probability paths (AIC) — these are cheap, model-free wins. Do not implement the full HJB quoter unless GSE actually operates a quoting book.

title: Bayesian Conway-Maxwell-Poisson model with spike-and-slab priors for dispersed count data with application to football scores
improvement: Port the CMP spike-and-slab model to NFL team points (starting from the released repo code, adding Dixon-Coles score-dependence and exponential recency weighting) as a challenger to GSE v5.2.7's totals predictions, replacing full MCMC with a Laplace/VI approximation for production.
gate: ADOPT into the GSE totals pipeline if CMP-SAS beats the Poisson-Maher baseline on out-of-sample IGN for totals in >=2 of 3 seasons AND identifies >=3 teams/season with P(Z_i=1)>0.5 (dispersion heterogeneity exists in NFL scoring); REJECT if no team crosses the 0.5 threshold in any season or IGN gains vanish.

title: WorldCupArena: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Language Models and Deep-Research Agents on Football Forecasting
improvement: Adopt the Scoreline partial-credit metric (45 points for the correct outcome class plus margin/total closeness terms) together with availability-aware aggregation and the lock-before-deadline/score-after verification protocol as GSE's internal engine-evaluation and public-pick verification machinery.
gate: The gate for GSE: the Scoreline metric must change model-variant rankings vs raw accuracy on GSE's own data (reproducing the paper's RQ1), or it is decorative. Do not adopt the display calibration (eq. 3) for external reporting — report raw scores.

title: Ledger 0797 — Wisdom of LLM Crowds: Aggregation and Contamination in Language Model Ensembles
improvement: Replace GSE's ensemble combiner with an L2 logistic regression over source probabilities that weights by error decorrelation (keeping negatively-weighted sources as contrastive bias corrections) plus pairwise disagreement features, with strict training-cutoff hygiene for all LLM/news-derived features.
gate: Learned linear aggregate must beat the arithmetic mean by >=5% Brier on the held-out season, with the error-decorrelation replication r_s >= 0.3, before production. No nonlinear aggregator needed — LR sufficiency is a paper result.

title: APMM: Automated Parlay Market Maker
improvement: Build a correlation-aware SGP fair-value layer that prices every same-game parlay from GSE's per-leg marginals plus shared pairwise (order<=2) interaction parameters instead of independence multiplication, with hub-concentration exposure throttles against concentrated low-order informed flow.
gate: Gate (ADAPT): the correlation-discount mechanism is real and quantified (0.6%-6.2% trader price improvement by order, pooled 0.978; near-zero aggregate maker loss in replay). Improvement: fit the hierarchy on NFL same-game props instead of NBA and extend to order-3 interactions.

title: The triumphs and tragedies of fandom: Emotional arcs in NFL tweets
